scope: Selected PolyU Department of Computing subjects and advising facts. This is a dated, partial reference set, not a programme handbook or live enrolment service.

entries.title: Data Structures
entries.summary: Develops ways to organise data using lists, queues, trees and heaps, then apply sorting, searching and hashing in programs.
entries.summaryZh: 学习用链表、队列、树和堆组织数据，并在程序中应用排序、搜索和哈希。
entries.prerequisite: One of COMP1011, COMP1012 or ENG2002. Exclusions: COMP2013 and DSAI2201.
entries.prerequisiteZh: 先修课程为 COMP1011、COMP1012 或 ENG2002 其中之一；排斥课程为 COMP2013 和 DSAI2201。

entries.title: Object-oriented Programming
entries.summary: Builds object-oriented software through classes, encapsulation, inheritance and polymorphism, with interfaces, exceptions, generic programming, concurrency and UML modelling.
entries.summaryZh: 学习类、封装、继承与多态，并涉及接口、异常、泛型、并发和 UML 建模。
entries.prerequisite: One of COMP1011, COMP1012 or ENG2002.
entries.prerequisiteZh: 先修课程为 COMP1011、COMP1012 或 ENG2002 其中之一。

entries.title: Computer Networking
entries.summary: Explores network layers, routing and addressing, TCP/UDP communication and socket programming, connecting networking principles to working applications.
entries.summaryZh: 学习网络分层、路由与寻址、TCP/UDP 通信和套接字编程，并将网络原理应用于实际程序。
entries.prerequisite: One of COMP1011, COMP1012 or ENG2002.
entries.prerequisiteZh: 先修课程为 COMP1011、COMP1012 或 ENG2002 其中之一。

entries.title: Database Systems
entries.summary: Covers relational data modelling, SQL, normalisation and indexing, plus query processing, transactions and recovery for database applications.
entries.summaryZh: 学习关系数据建模、SQL、规范化与索引，以及数据库应用中的查询处理、事务和恢复。
entries.prerequisite: One of COMP1011, COMP1012 or ENG2002.
entries.prerequisiteZh: 先修课程为 COMP1011、COMP1012 或 ENG2002 其中之一。

entries.title: Design and Analysis of Algorithms
entries.summary: Studies algorithm efficiency and design, including divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming, greedy methods, geometric problems and computational complexity.
entries.summaryZh: 学习算法效率与设计方法，包括分治、动态规划、贪心策略、几何问题和计算复杂性。
entries.prerequisite: One of COMP2011, COMP2013, DSAI2201 or EIE3320, or an equivalent subject.
entries.prerequisiteZh: 先修课程为 COMP2011、COMP2013、DSAI2201 或 EIE3320 其中之一，或获认可的同等课程。

entries.title: Web Application Design and Development
entries.summary: Builds interactive web applications with client/server architecture, APIs and databases. The syllabus includes JavaScript/TypeScript, modern frameworks and cloud deployment.
entries.summaryZh: 通过客户端与服务器架构、API 和数据库开发交互式网页应用，内容涉及 JavaScript/TypeScript、现代框架和云部署。
entries.prerequisite: One of COMP1011, COMP1012 or ENG2002.
entries.prerequisiteZh: 先修课程为 COMP1011、COMP1012 或 ENG2002 其中之一。

entries.title: Computer Vision
entries.summary: Applies machine learning and deep neural models to images: enhancement, feature extraction, classification, detection, segmentation and generation.
entries.summaryZh: 将机器学习和深度神经网络用于图像增强、特征提取、分类、检测、分割与生成。
entries.prerequisite: COMP1011 or COMP1012; ENG2002 is also listed for EEE students.
entries.prerequisiteZh: 先修课程为 COMP1011 或 COMP1012；EEE 学生也可按说明使用 ENG2002。

entries.title: Artificial Intelligence
entries.summary: Introduces intelligent agents, knowledge representation, search and reasoning, along with learning methods and ethical questions in AI applications.
entries.summaryZh: 介绍智能体、知识表示、搜索与推理，同时涉及机器学习方法和人工智能应用中的伦理问题。
entries.prerequisite: One of COMP2011, COMP2013 or DSAI2201.
entries.prerequisiteZh: 先修课程为 COMP2011、COMP2013 或 DSAI2201 其中之一。

entries.title: Machine Learning
entries.summary: Studies predictive and unsupervised models, model evaluation and dimensionality reduction, with applications such as recognition and tracking.
entries.summaryZh: 学习预测模型、无监督模型、模型评估和降维，并应用于识别与跟踪等任务。
entries.prerequisite: The July 2021 description lists no formal prerequisite. Prior AI/data analytics exposure and basic linear algebra and probability are recommended preparation, not compulsory prerequisite courses.
entries.prerequisiteZh: 2021 年 7 月说明没有列出正式先修课程；建议具备人工智能或数据分析基础，以及线性代数和概率知识。这些是建议准备，并非必修先修课。

entries.title: Computing & AI scheme: credit requirements
entries.titleZh: Computing & AI 学科组合：学分要求
entries.summary: The scheme FAQ gives 120 credits for a major, including discipline-specific, university and elective components. A student's actual award requirements depend on their programme, cohort, entry route and approved credit transfers; a total alone does not establish graduation eligibility.
entries.summaryZh: 学科组合 FAQ 列出主修的总要求为 120 学分，包含专业、大学通识及选修部分。个人毕业要求仍须按专业、入学年级、入学途径及获批学分转移核对；总学分不能单独证明毕业资格。

entries.title: Computing: Work-Integrated Education
entries.summary: The department FAQ states that full-time Computing undergraduates must complete at least 312 hours of WIE. WIE is assessed as pass/fail and does not contribute to GPA. Confirm the rules applying to your own cohort.
entries.summaryZh: 系内 FAQ 说明全日制 Computing 本科生须完成至少 312 小时 WIE，以通过或不通过评核，不计入 GPA。请核对适用于本人入学年级的具体规定。

entries.title: Computing & AI subject directory
entries.summary: The official directory groups subjects by level and links their descriptions. It distinguishes some subjects by admission year. Being listed in the directory does not confirm a particular semester's offering or a student's eligibility.
entries.summaryZh: 官方目录按级别列出课程并提供课程说明链接，部分课程按入学年区分。目录中的课程不代表某学期一定开设，也不代表个人已符合选课资格。
